correctness.rationale: An exhaustive integral stabilizer calculation reduces 22^4 images of a primitive basis to 52 times 12 necessary admissible pairs; all 624 survivors are checked for determinant and the full 22-vertex set, yielding exactly I and the displayed involution. Exact primitive supporting-facet generation and rank-two intersections reproduce the 72 and 68 two-face inventories. The 26 square-diagonal relation columns have rank 18 and exactly two coloops. The signed involution action preserves the relation map, and exact rational image ranks 9 and 9 from eigen-domain ranks 14 and 12 give kernel multiplicities 5 and 3. All checks are implemented as complete, deterministic integer/fraction calculations in verify.py, which was run successfully. Wuebben Theorem 6.1 and Remark 6.3 provide the exact geometric setting; the new finite computations and rank argument independently verify the additional claims.

value.rationale: The chosen 22-vertex polytope is unique among the classified doubly isolated Batyrev mirror pairs in carrying the nonsmoothable Hirzebruch F1 local model. Its complete two-element lattice-symmetry group acts nontrivially and differently on the nodal strata of the two mirrors, rather than just on arbitrary vertices. The new 5+3 eigenspace character and the exchange of the two forced-zero coloop nodes refine the bare rank/circuit data relevant to equivariant conifold deformation obstructions. This naturally motivated, full object-specific classification is not a textbook identity, random slice, or recomputation of a known table. The stated limitations avoid claims about actual smoothing or arbitrary generic Calabi–Yau automorphisms.
